findings.title: Per-client resource shadows all-clients permission
findings.body: When a client-specific resource exists (created by any permission for that client, e.g. one granting only CONFIGURE), only that resource is evaluated and the 'Clients' all-resource permission is never consulted. An admin holding an all-clients MANAGE/VIEW permission is denied on that client as soon as someone adds an unrelated per-client permission. The fallback should also evaluate the type resource, as UserPermissionsV2 does.

findings.title: Removal listener now runs in V2 and throws UnsupportedOperationException
findings.body: The listener is gated on ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ, but management() returns MgmtPermissionsV2 whenever V2 is enabled. If both features are enabled, deleting a client calls ClientPermissionsV2.setPermissionsEnabled, which throws UnsupportedOperationException. The client deletion then fails.

findings.title: getClientsWithPermission includes the 'Clients' type resource
findings.body: findByType for CLIENTS_RESOURCE_TYPE also returns the all-clients resource, whose name is "Clients" rather than a client id. That bogus id is added to the result set. In addition, per-client resources created via getOrCreateResource are never given a type, so findByType may not find them at all.

findings.title: Possible NPE when type resource is missing
findings.body: getResourceTypeResource can return null, for example in older realms initialized before the Clients type was added. That null is passed to findByResource and later dereferenced via resource.getScopes(), causing an NPE instead of a deny.

findings.title: getResourceName not updated for Clients type
findings.body: For client permissions the resource name is the client's internal UUID, and getResourceName falls back to the display name. As a result, the admin UI shows raw UUIDs instead of the clientId or an "All clients" label.
